sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of PC and Console Video Games via Digital Stores

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Greater Luxembourg legal family with Napoleonic Code influence)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: EU Intra-EU Arbitration Convention (parallel DTA arbitration regime)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Luxembourg Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended; Law of 13 January 2019 establishing a central Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE Law); Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies, as amended; Luxembourg Civil Code, Book I, Title III; Grand-Ducal Regulation of 1 February 2019 on RBE filing modalities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization by the Luxembourg Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) of each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company or deposit-taking bank branch office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization by the Luxembourg Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming identity and legitimate background of UBO(s) and manager(s)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: A regulated credit institution in the UBO's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance certificate (criminal record extract) for each manager and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent judicial or administrative authority of the country of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: The Luxembourg AML/CFT framework mandates automated screening of all UBOs and directors against: (a) national politically exposed persons (PEP) lists; (b) the OFAC SDN list; (c) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list; (d) the UN Security Council sanctions lists; and (e) CSSF public administrative sanctions. Screening is required before appointment, on an ongoing basis, and immediately before any material transaction.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) online portal: https://www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be expressed in Latin characters; French is the official filing language for the RCS. Trade names may be in any language using Latin transliteration. The legal form abbreviation 'SARL' must correspond exactly to the statutory form. Names that are identical, confusingly similar, or that are transliterated to cause phonetic resemblance to an existing RCS registrant are rejected.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any term requiring prior ministerial or sectoral authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the RCS rejects a name application, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Directoire de l'Administration de l'Enregistrement et des Domaines within 15 calendar days of the rejection notification. Alternatively, a judicial review application may be filed with the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement) within one month of the rejection. A new amended name may be submitted at any time during the appellate process.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not sufficient for a company engaged in active video game publishing. The RCS requires a physical registered office within Luxembourg where statutory records, minutes, and corporate seals are kept. A virtual or serviced hall office may be accepted only for an initial shell entity, but the company must establish a substantive physical presence (real premises or a leased operational office) before commencing revenue-generating Steam or PlayStation publishing operations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 20% annual probability for a digital publishing company with annual turnover above EUR 100,000. The likelihood increases to 35% once the entity exceeds VAT registration thresholds or applies for Luxembourg VAT RCS registration. Unannounced on-site inspections by the RCS, the Administration de l'enregistrement, and the CSSF (for AML purposes only) are regularly performed.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and name reservation at Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official fixed fee published in the Grand-Ducal Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the articles of association (statutes) and draft deed for a SARL
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff calculated on the subscribed share capital (minimum capital EUR 12,000); prevailing market rate for deed drafting

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RBE (Register of Beneficial Owners) UBO filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés / Luxembourg Business Registers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative handling fee for RBE electronic filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office address service for one year (physical office minimum)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent registered office / serviced office provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard small SARL office in Luxembourg City or Kirchberg

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation AML/CFT due diligence and KYC compliance review of UBOs and directors by a Luxembourg law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing hourly rate for corporate AML compliance work (2–4 hours at EUR 200–250/hour)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization of three personal documents (passport, address proof, police certificate)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg Ministry of Foreign Affairs and/or competent Luxembourg consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official fixed fee per document for the Hague Apostille and optional consular certification

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank reference letter fee for UBO(s) and manager(s)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Standard bank administrative fee for certified reference letter

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Loi modifiée du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), Book I, Title V, Articles 710-1 to 710-25 (Société à Responsabilité Limitée).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers / Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), LBR - Maison du Nombre, 5-7, rue Plaetis, L-2338 Luxembourg.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Articles of Association (Acte constitutif / statuts) together with the application for registration in the RCS and the declaration concerning the registered office.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: SARL minimum share capital is EUR 12,000, fully subscribed at incorporation; at least 20% of each share (minimum EUR 2,400 in aggregate) must be paid up at signing of the notarial deed. Cash contributions must be deposited into a blocked escrow account with a Luxembourg credit institution before the deed; the notary verifies payment and issues a capital blocking certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that each subscriber hereby subscribes to the number of shares set opposite their name and irrevocably contributes the minimum mandatory paid-up capital in cash, in accordance with Article 710-1 of the Luxembourg Companies Act. RESOLVED, that the registered office shall be fixed at the address designated in the Articles of Association within Luxembourg, and that the Luxembourg Commercial Register shall be the competent filing office. RESOLVED, that [Name A] and [Name B] are appointed as the first managers (‘gérants’) of the company, each acting individually, with the full power to represent the company in all acts. RESOLVED, that the managers are directed to complete the RCS, RESA, VAT, social security, and banking formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS) via notary / e-Registre
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a Luxembourg notary to request confirmation from the RCS that the proposed corporate name is available and complies with Luxembourg naming rules. The notary also validates the legality of the corporate object (objet social) against the Law of 10 August 1915.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a negative name opinion, submit a corrected name proposal through the notary and re-file within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of blocked capital escrow account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution (e.g. BGL BNP Paribas, Spuerkeess) or notary escrow account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deposit the minimum paid-up capital (EUR 2,400 out of the subscribed EUR 12,000) into a special blocked account in the name of the company in formation. The bank issues a certificate of capital blockage addressed to the notary, evidencing payment and identifying the contributors.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the deposit for AML reasons, supplement source of funds documentation and request the bank to re-issue the blocking certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of notarial deed of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary reads the statutory clauses, verifies capital payment through the blocked account certificate, confirms the managers' consent, and signs the notarial deed of incorporation (acte constitutif) with all founders. The deed is drawn up in French and becomes binding as of signature.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries a statutory clause, sign an addendum rectifying the clause before lodging the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) / Luxembourg Business Registers; RESA (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary transmits the notarized deed and the legal representative's e-form to the RCS through the LBR portal. Once verified, the RCS issues the registration number and national business number. The deed is simultaneously published in the RESA, giving legal opposability to third parties.
required_dossiers: Registered office lease or domiciliation agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS files an opposition or query, counsel corrects the filing through the notary and re-submits within the statutory ten-day cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VAT, social security, and beneficial owner registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS); Luxembourg Business Registers (RBE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Luxembourg VAT number using form 010 via MyGuichet, register the company as an employer with the CCSS, and file the beneficial ownership declaration with the Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) within one month of incorporation.
required_dossiers: IDs and addresses of beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VAT application is delayed, submit a formal request for a provisional VAT number and, if necessary, apply for a corrective adjustment with the VAT office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial bank account opening and corporate set-up completion
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the RCS extract and organizational documents to a Luxembourg bank to open a corporate current account for Steam and PlayStation settlement. Issue share certificates, open statutory registers, and appoint a professional domiciliation service if required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, provide additional corporate structure and transaction flow explanations; appeal to the bank's compliance committee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – Ministry of the Economy (Ministère de l'Économie) only for commercial establishment authorization; digital publishing is unlicensed under Luxembourg law.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None – no sector-specific operating license is required for PC/console software publishing; the RCS registration and VAT number constitute sufficient authorizations for this activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement (Environment Authority of Luxembourg)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – activities confined to office/publishing with no production facility; no EIA report required under the Law of 15 May 2018.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emissions generated. General waste management under Luxembourg waste law (Law of 21 March 2017); office energy performance standards under the EPBD apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety compliance for office premises under the Inspection générale de la sécurité sociale (IGSS); structural load and egress inspection by the commune; occupational accident insurance with the Association d'assurance accident (AAA).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) — direct corporate income tax; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AED) — VAT and indirect tax; unified administrative portal via MyGuichet.lu and guichet.public.lu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a non-resident-owned SARL: (1) execute incorporation deed before a Luxembourg notary and deposit share capital with a regulated bank; (2) file registration with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) through the e-Desk on MyGuichet.lu, obtaining the national business registration number (matricule); (3) register for VAT with the AED using Form 700 B (resident taxable person) or, if the company is non-established, the specific 'Form 700 Controller' procedure for non-established taxable persons to obtain a Luxembourg VAT identification number (format LU + 8 digits); (4) obtain no additional exchange-control or investment approval, as Luxembourg operates full capital liberalisation for non-resident investors.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or US-style entity classification election exists under Luxembourg domestic law. A SARL is mandatorily resident and subject to Luxembourg corporate income tax (IRC) on worldwide income, without pass-through opt-out. Available statutory elections: (1) joint VAT filing via the 'assujetti unique' election under Article 50 of the Luxembourg VAT Law (LTVAG), allowing an integrated group to be treated as a single VAT taxpayer; (2) option to tax real-estate transactions under Article 44 LTVAG; (3) hybrid mismatch elections restricted to the mandatory alignment rules of EU ATAD 2 as transposed by the Luxembourg law of 20 December 2019; no elective fiscal transparency regime applies to SARLs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Non-established foreign suppliers have no registration threshold: any taxable supply made in Luxembourg triggers immediate compulsory VAT registration. Domestic taxable persons may benefit from the Article 57 LTVAG small-business franchise exemption for annual turnover not exceeding EUR 35,000, but the franchise is excluded for cross-border supplies and certain electronic/digital services; a digital game publisher using marketplace distribution must register for VAT from the first taxable operation and cannot shelter under the franchise threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg has no real-time fiscal clearance, national e-invoicing clearance system, or mandatory digital stamping as of the current effective tax period. B2G e-invoicing is mandated through the PEPPOL network. Transposition of the EU VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA) package mandating standardised B2B e-invoicing is pending, with expected applicability no earlier than the EU-mandated transitional dates; until then, structured e-invoices (EN 16931) or standard PDF invoices are legally sufficient for VAT audit and deduction purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Physical exports of goods outside the EU qualify for the 0% rate with full input VAT deduction upon proof of physical consignment out of the EU (customs export declaration and transport evidence). Supplies of digital game publishing services or electronic content to non-EU business customers are outside the scope of Luxembourg VAT, functionally equivalent to zero-rating with input VAT deductibility, provided the customer's establishment outside the EU is proven. For sales to EU consumers via digital storefronts (Steam, PlayStation Store), the marketplace operator is the deemed supplier for VAT purpose; the LU SARL accounts for tax only on B2B distribution/royalty flows, reverse-charged where the counterparty is established in the EU, and zero-rated/outside the scope where the counterparty is established outside the EU.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate

Single Administrative Document and transport documents (CMR, air waybill) evidencing physical exit from the EU, or equivalent non-EU customer establishment evidence (VAT registration number, business registry extract, IP address/billing evidence) for digital service exports
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AED may retroactively recharacterise an unsubstantiated zero-rating or outside-the-scope supply as a taxable Luxembourg supply at 17%, assessing the VAT due plus late-payment interest of 0.8% per month and a civil penalty of EUR 750 to EUR 12,500 for knowingly false declarations; fraudulent suppression or misrepresentation is criminally punishable with imprisonment from 8 days to 5 years and fines up to EUR 12,500 under the law of 30 July 2001. Export refund claims audited post-clearance also expose the taxpayer to cross-border information exchange risks and to clawback of deducted input VAT on recovered costs.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) in coordination with the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) for prudential supervision; the BCL is the central bank and the Luxembourg authority responsible for monetary operations, balance-of-payments statistics and euro-area financial stability.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg is fully integrated into the euro area and maintains full convertibility of the euro under the free movement of capital guaranteed by the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. There are no exchange-control restrictions on current account or capital account transactions, no central bank approval for foreign currency transfers, and no limits on profit or dividend remittance. Profit distribution to shareholders is subject only to applicable Luxembourg withholding tax, corporate compliance and AML/source-of-wealth verification standards.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export proceeds surrender requirement or mandatory conversion ratio in Luxembourg. Export receipts derived from Steam, PlayStation Store or other digital store payouts may be retained in euro or foreign currency without forcible conversion. The BCL only imposes statistical reporting obligations on cross-border direct investment and foreign asset/liability positions for resident enterprises, but these do not operate as currency controls.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE / Spuerkeess)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-to-high viability as a supplementary liquidity rail, not as the primary statutory bank. Luxembourg-authorised or EU-passported fintech EMIs may offer remote onboarding and instant disbursement capabilities, which is useful for daily Steam/PlayStation payout flows and royalty payments. However, a fintech EMI is not the preferred depository for share capital escrow or long-term treasury balances because it is not a credit institution and does not benefit from the full Luxembourg deposit guarantee scheme in the same manner as a commercial bank. Legal constraints require money safeguarding, segregation of client funds, and compliance with e-money limits under PSD2; for conservative treasury governance, a tier-1 bank should hold the core operating account with the EMI used only for payment disbursement acceleration.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Luxembourg AML legislation does not impose a categorical statutory rule that directors must appear physically. In practice, tier-1 banks apply a risk-based approach: non-resident directors and ultimate beneficial owners may be onboarded using video identification if the quality of identity verification meets CSSF expectations, but many banks still require at least one physical interview at a Luxembourg branch or notarised documents originating from a recognised law firm. For a cross-border digital publisher, the strong recommendation is to have a Luxembourg-resident authorised signatory and to complete physical KYC interviews for the statutory tail, while remote video KYC is acceptable only when supported by notarised corporate extracts and verified UBO identification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Luxembourg SARL with non-resident shareholders, foreign directors and no local operating substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide an updated RCS extract, notarised deed, current share registry, register of beneficial owners (RBE filing), valid passports, tax residence certificates, a local lease/substance agreement, anticipated payroll records and a board resolution authorising bank opening; evidence the commercial role of the Luxembourg entity in Steam publishing, IP licensing and sales reconciliation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incoming payment flows from Steam/Valve and PlayStation Store through digital platforms with aggregated players and cross-border platform accounts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supply signed publisher/distribution agreements with Valve Corporation and PlayStation/PlayStation Store, platform payout statements for the preceding 6 months, reconciliation of the SARL's publisher dashboard, end-user revenue recognition methodology, breakdown between sales proceeds and withholdings/taxes, and source-of-funds evidence derived from the platform payment ledger.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large or unexpected capital injection from a foreign shareholder shortly after incorporation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised capital increase decision, shareholders' agreement confirming contribution, funds source declaration, bank reference letter from the remitting bank, tax identification numbers of the shareholder, UBO economic profile and a written explanation of the commercial purpose, including acquisition of publishing rights or games catalogue expansion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border royalty disbursements to overseas game developers, intermediaries or collection agencies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Arm's-length intercompany development/publishing agreement, international taxation and transfer pricing report, valid licences, end-user royalty computation schedules, PI/headcount and substance evidence, names and addresses of the receiving entities, and bank/payment instructions verified by the compliance department.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections from an EEA euro area shareholder should be settled by SEPA Credit Transfer, or SWIFT MT103 for non-EEA and USD transfers. Payment purpose must be transparently stated, for example 'shareholder capital contribution under the Luxembourg Companies Law' or 'share capital increase contribution'; the receiving Luxembourg bank will require a notarised corporate resolution, updated share register, UBO identification and a bank/statistical declaration to the Banque centrale du Luxembourg for balance-of-payments purposes. For US or Asian parent funding, the SWIFT MT103 should include the exact invoice/capital increase reference in field 70, identify the remitter as the equity holder, and be routed via an established correspondent; no SEPA transfer should be used if the economic substance is not clearly compatible with a simple intercompany payment.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Royalty and revenue-share payments to non-EEA developers and publishers are normally executed via SWIFT MT103 with express invoice and licence references, while larger milestone or development advances may be secured using a Commercial Letter of Credit (UCP600) issued by a Luxembourg or EU bank or backed by a standby letter of credit. Steam/Valve and PlayStation Store platform payouts enter the Luxembourg SARL's treasury account as SEPA or SWIFT credits and are then netted against outbound disbursements to licensees; intra-euro-area payments settle under SEPA Instant/SCT rails. For USD-based developers, the treasury team should centralise USD and EUR disbursement accounts and tie every payment to a verified publishing contract to maintain audit trail and KYC continuity.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: SPOT FX contracts for EUR/USD cash settlement of immediate platform payouts
Outright deliverable EUR/USD FX forward contracts up to 24 months
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing USD or other soft currencies where EUR settlement is required and the hedge is documented under EMIR end-user exemption
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for longer-term EUR/USD exposure
European-style FX option strategies for premium-limited hedging of Steam and PlayStation store sales proceeds

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual accounts by the shareholders at the ordinary general meeting and grant of discharge to the manager
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders of the SARL (internal governance act; minutes retained in the statutory minute book)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the financial year-end; for a calendar-year SARL, by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late approval delays the RCS filing and triggers the EUR 500-5,000 administrative late-filing penalty; no separate government fine for the meeting itself

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of the approved annual accounts (comptes annuels) with the Luxembourg Business Registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after the financial year-end; for a calendar-year SARL, by 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of EUR 500-5,000 per late or non-filed annual accounts (Art. 74, Law of 19 December 2020); non-filing for two consecutive financial years may lead to a formal 6-month warning and compulsory strike-off (radiation) upon court order

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of the beneficial owner declaration (RBE / UBO register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year, with the annual confirmation due by 31 December; any share transfer changing beneficial ownership must be declared within 30 days of the transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine of EUR 500-1,250 for failure to declare or confirm (RBE Law of 13 January 2019, Art. 30); directors may be subject to further penalties for knowingly false UBO declarations; failure to confirm may be published by the LBR

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory register audit and certification (members register, directors register, minute book and corporate records)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Board of managers of the SARL (annual internal audit); registers available to the RCS, RBE authorities and notaries upon official demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the ordinary general meeting date (typically by 30 June); the maintenance obligation is continuous throughout the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-maintenance of statutory registers is an offense under the Law of 10 August 1915 and the AML/RBE regime; may result in court-ordered production, director civil/criminal liability and RBE compliance fines

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a réviseur d'entreprises agréé where the SARL exceeds at least two of the three thresholds in Art. 67 of the Law of 10 August 1915 for two consecutive financial years: balance-sheet total EUR 6.0 million, net turnover EUR 12.0 million, average workforce 50; micro-undertakings (balance sheet up to EUR 350,000, net turnover up to EUR 700,000, up to 10 employees) qualify for abbreviated accounts and audit exemption
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (Plan Comptable Général Luxembourgeois) under the Law of 10 August 1915, as amended, transposing EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU; EU-endorsed IFRS is permissible for non-listed companies including SARLs

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The RBE declaration is filed electronically via the LBR portal; the SARL must confirm at least once per calendar year (by 31 December) that the UBO information remains accurate; any share transfer that changes direct or indirect beneficial ownership must be reflected both in the register of members and in the RBE declaration within 30 days of the transfer, specifying the nature of control, ownership percentages and the identifying details of each ultimate natural-person owner
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Managers (Registre des Gérants)
Minute Book (Procès-Verbaux des Assemblées Générales et Décisions des Associés)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,600-4,900 (EUR 1,500-4,500) per year for licensed Luxembourg domiciliation and registered-agent services including registered address, mail handling and corporate secretarial support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 8,700-27,300 (EUR 8,000-25,000) per year for a certified statutory audit when the audit thresholds are exceeded; no audit fee applies while the SARL qualifies for the micro or small undertaking exemption

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 16% for income year 2024 (impôt sur le revenu des collectivités, IRC); 15% from income year 2025; plus 7% solidarity surcharge (contribution au fonds pour l'emploi) on IRC and municipal business tax (impôt commercial communal, ICC) of 3.0% x 225% municipal coefficient (Luxembourg City) = 6.75%; aggregate combined statutory burden approx. 23.87% (2024) and 22.80% (2025) for Luxembourg City.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: i) Participation exemption: 100% exemption for qualifying dividends and capital gains (>=10% holding or >=EUR 1.2M acquisition price, held >=12 months, no 50% gross-up for dividends from taxable/ELTIF sources); ii) IP Box (Art. 50ter LIR): 80% exemption of net qualifying IP income (video game software copyrights) producing effective aggregate rate of approx. 4.77% (2024); iii) Notional Interest Deduction (Art. 168 LIR) on new risk equity; iv) Unlimited tax-loss carryforward; v) EUR 500,000 net wealth tax allowance for the annual wealth tax (impôt sur la fortune, IFT) at 0.5%; vi) EU/domestic group consolidation currently unavailable, but AEIR? no – use separate entity taxation.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward period (no statutory expiry), subject to forfeiture upon a change of more than 50% in ownership unless the business continuity condition of Art. 114 LIR is met.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1002 (Déclaration d'impôt sur le revenu des collectivités, de l'impôt commercial communal et de l'impôt sur la fortune) filed electronically via the eCDF portal on MyGuichet.lu; mandatory e-filing for corporate taxpayers; individual sheet supplements for the ICC municipal tax calculation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Statutory filing deadline is 31 May of the year following the tax year (calendar year N, due 31 May N+1); automatic administrative extension to 31 December N+1 is granted for e-filed returns; further extension available upon justified request. Quarterly prepayments (acomptes) are due 10 March, 10 June, 10 September, 20 December.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter the Luxembourg national business register number (N° d'immatriculation RCS/BCE LU), legal form SARL, address of registered office, and contact details of the appointed tax representative.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SARL files under its own all-resident status; non-resident shareholders must not be entered as the taxpayer. If a non-resident EU parent holds >=10%, identify the parent company and its tax residence in the annex to support dividend WHT relief.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section II – Profit and loss account (Résultat comptable avant impôt)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report the accounting net profit/loss before tax, including Steam (Valve) and PlayStation Store gross sales revenue, platform commissions, co-development costs, IP amortization, and operating expenses, per the approved annual accounts of the SARL.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All income from Luxembourg Steam/PlayStation publishing activities must be accrued to the SARL. Do not exclude foreign platform sales unless there is a documented permanent establishment abroad; the form cannot be filed by the foreign parent on the SARL's behalf without a power of attorney (mandat).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add back non-deductible expenses: corporate income tax itself, solidarity surcharge and ICC, non-deductible provisions, expenses exceeding the arm's length threshold in related-party transactions, fines, and 50% of representation/hospitality costs above legal caps where applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify that management fees paid to the non-resident parent or affiliates are supported by contracts and economic substance to avoid forced reintegration; payments to EU blacklist entities trigger the 15% WHT and are non-deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declare the deductions applied to the accounting base: 100% participation-exempt dividends/capital gains, 80% IP Box exemption for qualifying video game revenue (with nexus ratio computation), Notional Interest Deduction on new qualifying equity, and tax-loss carryforward from prior years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the form 540 tax-residence certificate of the foreign parent if participation exemption is claimed on intercompany dividends; keep nexus-tracked records linking qualifying IP expenditure to Steam/PlayStation income for the IP Box audit trail.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section V – Tax computation (Base imposable x IRC + surcharge + ICC)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute taxable income after adjustments; apply 16% IRC; add 7% solidarity surcharge on the IRC; apply ICC at 3.0% multiplied by the municipal coefficient (e.g., 225% for Luxembourg City = 6.75%) on the adjusted taxable base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign parent should verify consistency between the SARL's taxable income and the group's transfer-pricing documentation; any adjustment in Luxembourg affects the foreign creditor's DTA credit position.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section VI – Net wealth tax (Impôt sur la fortune)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declare net taxable assets (net book value of assets less liabilities, adjusted for participation exemptions and the EUR 500,000 allowance) and compute IFT at 0.5% on the excess.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Participation exemption for net wealth tax applies where the overall profit is exempt under the participation regime; non-resident shareholders' loans are deductible debt if at arm's length and not reclassified as equity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late-filing and formal-default administrative fines range from EUR 250 to EUR 10,000 per return (Law of 25 March 2020); late-payment interest accrues at 0.8% per month or fraction thereof on unpaid IRC/ICC/IFT; fraudulent non-filing exposes the SARL to a fine up to EUR 250,000 and imprisonment of the manager; a late-filed or incomplete eCDF return triggers an estimated tax assessment (taxation d'office).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% statutory withholding tax on dividends (Art. 146 LIR) payable by the SARL on distributions to non-resident shareholders; 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (>=10% capital, >=12 months holding, no abuse); DTA-reduced rates typically 0%-5% for holdings >=10% (e.g., 0% under LU-US, 5% under LU-JP), 15% for portfolio holdings.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: 1) The SARL must secure a Luxembourg tax residence certificate (Formulaire 540 – certificat de résidence fiscale) from the Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for its own withholding obligations; 2) the non-resident parent obtains its domestic tax residency certificate and submits it to the SARL before the dividend record date; 3) the SARL files the exemption or reduced-rate application with the ACD/RTS using the pre-payment relief forms (Form 770/771 for EU Directive relief; refund route via Form 780 when relief is claimed after withholding); 4) all documents (TRCs, share register, holding-period computation) must be retained for at least 5 years; 5) an absence of economic substance or a scheme considered artificial will result in denial of treaty benefits under the Luxembourg GAAR (Art. 6 AO) and the Principal Purpose Test.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: No general Luxembourg withholding tax on outbound royalties or interest. Exception: a 15% WHT applies on interest and royalty payments made to associated enterprises resident in jurisdictions on the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions (Law of 23 December 2020). Steam (Valve) and PlayStation Store platform commissions are distribution and transaction-processing service fees, not royalties, and are paid free of Luxembourg WHT. Outbound license royalties to a foreign IP owner under a DTA are covered by the royalty articles (typically 0%-10%, e.g., 0% LU-US, 10% LU-JP); they remain free of WHT in Luxembourg except to blacklisted recipients.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory when the Luxembourg entity's net turnover exceeds EUR 1 million AND the consolidated group revenue exceeds EUR 50 million; Master File mandatory when consolidated group revenue exceeds EUR 50 million; Country-by-Country Report at consolidated group revenue above EUR 750 million (Law of 23 December 2020, effective FY2022). Separate contemporaneous documentation is required for IP Box nexus and participation exemption claims.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg does not maintain Caribbean-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR), but substance is a statutory condition embedded in: i) the Luxembourg GAAR (Art. 6 Abgabenordnung) and the EU ATAD General Abuse Rule; ii) the participation exemption's non-abuse condition; iii) the IP Box nexus activity requirement (active ownership and execution of development functions in Luxembourg); iv) the tax-residence test for management and control of the SARL; v) the Pillar Two GloBE rules (15% minimum tax law of 21 December 2023, effective 1 January 2024 for MNE groups with revenue >=EUR 750M). For the Steam/PlayStation publishing SARL, sustained substance requires qualified employees with game-publishing decision rights, actual contract negotiation and platform-account administration in Luxembourg, local bank accounts, and board minutes evidencing real management of Steam and PlayStation sales.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful omission or understatement of Steam/PlayStation Store gross receipts; fabrication of invoices for fake co-development, marketing, or platform-advisory services; directing game-sales revenue to a foreign parent's PayPal/Epic/Steam wallet or bank account without recording it in the SARL's books; deliberate destruction of revenue records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine from EUR 1,000 up to EUR 250,000 and/or imprisonment from 1 month to 5 years (Law of 25 March 2020); administrative reassessment with 10% majoration and late-payment interest at 0.8% per month; publication of the final sanction in the official journal; forfeiture of IP Box and participation exemption benefits for the relevant years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Managing directors and de facto directors who conceived or tolerated the evasion are criminally liable; personal travel bans and precautionary seizures of personal assets may be ordered; the ACD may recover unpaid corporate taxes from directors through the 'action en comblement du passif' (Art. 480(1), Law of 10 August 1915) where gross negligence caused the company's asset insufficiency; directors face up to 10 years of management disqualification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: SARL exists solely as a Luxembourg invoicing vehicle: no employees, no local decision-making, no Steam/PS distribution activity, all functions performed by foreign affiliates, while Luxembourg profits are inflated to exploit the 80% IP Box and the participation exemption without real substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disregard of the tax position under Article 6 Abgabenordnung (GAAR) and EU ATAD; reallocation of profits to the actual function operator; denial of IP Box and participation exemption; assessment of unpaid IRC/ICC/IFT plus 10% majoration and 0.8% monthly interest; in egregious cases classified as fraud with criminal fines up to EUR 250,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be jointly liable for the reassessed corporate taxes if they approved the shell structure with knowledge; civil liability toward minority shareholders and creditors; travel restrictions for cross-border tax debts under EU Directive 2010/24/EU once exposure exceeds EUR 10,000.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare and file Local/Master File documentation despite triggered thresholds; intercompany pricing for sub-publishing rights, co-development fees, Steam marketing reimbursements, and group management fees set outside arm's length; no functional analysis or benchmark study.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transfer pricing adjustment to the arm's length result of the SARL; penalty of 10% of the net upward TP adjustment; mandatory documentation default fines from EUR 5,000 to EUR 250,000 under the Law of 23 December 2020; 0.8% monthly interest on the deficiency; criminal exposure if the TP misstatement is intentional.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign inaccurate TP declarations or knowingly omit documentation are personally liable for the penalty portion; external tax advisors face contractual and administrative liability; the ACD can extend recovery to directors who transferred funds out of the SARL to related parties during the adjustment period.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / UBO Registration (RBE) and Anonymous Ownership
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the beneficial owner (UBO) with the Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE) within 1 month of incorporation or after a shareholding change; use of nominee shareholders, bearer share certificates, or trust layers to conceal the true owner of the SARL; omission of the UBO of the foreign parent from the RBE declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fines up to EUR 5,000 per violation and/or imprisonment up to 6 months; registration restrictions with the Luxembourg Business Registers; blocking of dividend distributions; forced deregistration and dissolution of the SARL upon repeated non-compliance; AML supervisory penalties for the banking sponsor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally subject to the RBE criminal fines; UBOs identified through investigation face separate sanctions and precautionary freezing of their interests; professionals (banks, auditors, notaries) that assist concealment may be penalized under CSSF AML regulations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Late Filing / Non-Payment of Corporate Taxes
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submission of Form 1002 after 31 December of year N+1 without extension; non-payment of the quarterly prepayments of IRC/ICC/IFT; persistent tax arrears while continuing high distributions to shareholders; failure to file the annual accounts with the RCS within 6 months of the fiscal year-end.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late filing fine up to EUR 10,000; forced tax assessment (taxation d'office) on the ACD's discretionary basis; interest at 0.8% per month; enforcement by seizure (saisie-arrêt) of the SARL's receivables, including Steam and PlayStation platform balances, bank accounts, and IP receivables; RCS late-accounts fines up to EUR 2,000 per delayed filing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be surcharged personally for taxes not withheld (e.g., dividend WHT); travel bans and asset freezes ordered for tax debts exceeding EUR 10,000 under the EU Mutual Recovery Directive; the liquidator's failure to settle tax debts before distributions triggers personal restitution liability.
